160	When you have equivalence of form with the Creator, you need that kind of form, because otherwise you will never manage to be equivalent
161	ever.
162	It's the same thing in reverse.
163	If you don't have within you the form of a lower being, which is the body, yes, in this case,
164	then you won't be able to connect to reality: no eyes, no ears, no tools to connect to reality. You
165	need a form that in its very essence is external, that has externality.
166	If you don't have this form, you won't be able to connect to reality.
167	So this is the first condition for a person who wants to serve.
168	He needs to understand that he has a physical form, and that it has value.
169	Only with it does he connect to reality. Don't belittle anything you have, even the most physical, even the most...
170	even the desire to receive itself.
171	HaShem...
172	No, the ability, the ability to bestow, needs to have
173	equivalence of form with the one you are bestowing upon.
174	If you don't have that kind of form, you won't be able to bestow upon him, and there will be a disconnection.
175	He won't be able to connect to you, you won't be able to connect to him.
176	Yes, this is what is called "descending to the people."
177	But it's not descending to the people, it's being equivalent with the people.
178	You need to have the external form in you too, to accept it, to agree to it.
179	It doesn't end with your own experience.
180	Right.
181	Baal HaSulam said something called contact with the creatures, that's what the essay is called.
182	Contact with the creatures.
183	So he says that the higher a person is in levels of attainment, the more connected he is with
184	people.
185	Not as everyone thinks, that the prophet is somehow on a mountain. No.
186	The proof that you are more connected to yourself, yes?
187	You are more connected to the Creator, to your soul, is how it shows: that you can be more connected to all kinds of problematic
188	realities and contain them.
189	To contain, to bestow as well.
190	Yes.
191	So this is the first condition for a person to carry out his mission.
192	That he have the form of the upper and the lower beings.
193	That was it. The second condition says: he was included of all.
194	What is "included of all"?
195	"Included of all" means he needs to understand that every part of reality is also in him.
196	It is not like a ruler of form.
197	Every part of reality is a certain revelation of the wholeness.
198	And the wholeness includes everything.
199	There is no detail in reality that is unimportant, that has no meaning, that needs to be canceled.
